flashcard_questions.q: What is fusion in film music?
flashcard_questions.a: Blending features from different musical traditions into one score.

flashcard_questions.q: Which composer wrote the score for Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon?
In which year was Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon released?
Which Chinese instrument carries the main melody in Tan Dun's score?
flashcard_questions.a: The erhu, a two-stringed bowed instrument.
A smooth slide between two pitches.

flashcard_questions.q: Which Chinese plucked instrument is similar to a zither?
Which cellist plays the Western solo voice in Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon?
Which type of scale gives Tan Dun's melodies their Chinese character?
flashcard_questions.a: Pentatonic scales, five notes without semitones.

flashcard_questions.q: Which composer wrote the score for Black Panther?
In which year was Black Panther released?
Which African drums mimic speech patterns?
Which West African flute plays melodic motifs in the Black Panther score?
Which Senegalese drums drive the action scenes in Black Panther?

flashcard_questions.a: Several interlocking rhythms played at the same time.

flashcard_questions.q: What theme does the fusion in Black Panther represent?

notes: 15 cards: 6 on the Crouching Tiger case study (composer, year, erhu, guzheng, pentatonic scales, Yo-Yo Ma), 5 on Black Panther (composer, year, talking drums, Fula flute, sabar drums), 1 theme card, and 3 term-to-definition cards (fusion, glissando, polyrhythm). Instrument-to-tradition matching carries most of the deck. Bhangra was left to its own lesson deck to avoid duplicate cards across the two fusion lessons.
